solver_notes: Use explicit loop unroll budgets. StakingGraph maximum timeline case needs at least34; ZeroX ABI slice loops can need hundreds of iterations. Prefer separate concrete/FUZZ execution where flagged.
Metadata check is classified FUZZ despite test_check prefix. Its nested serialization loops are not intended as a full symbolic proof.
Counterexample contracts retain intended failing assertions. Root must reproduce and classify each result before treating it as a finding.
Source uintN arguments and constructive arithmetic avoid vm.assume rejection. No artificial full-range assumptions or tautological guard tests are used.

No suite has more than30 check functions. No solver was executed by this agent. Two root-authorized single-case Forge diagnostics, including their required compilation, were run and are linked in diagnostic_evidence.
fixtures: Transmuter uses actual production bytecode with exact-transfer ERC20 mock dependencies. Alchemist mock has identity share/debt conversion, explicit decimal normalization, configurable share-redemption shortfall, and restricted mutation calls.
Synthetic token totalSupply is not required to equal mock Alchemist issued supply. Claimed issuance decrease and Transmuter custody invariants are asserted separately.
Gauge seeded strategyList uses a disclosed harness because public registration never populates it. Nonempty allocation results are synthetic-state analysis.
Token wrappers use actual library code against explicit return-data mocks. ABI success does not establish token honesty.
Reentry candidate uses an adversarial synthetic token. This is distinct from baseline standard-token proofs.
Root owns real Alchemist+Transmuter+VaultV2 integration and production external dependency refinement.

semantic_gaps_without_a_test.gap: Cross-position nested claims and deposit/poke during claim are not exercised. Same-position callbacks at all five mutating settlement boundaries and one transferFrom deposit-cap candidate are present.
Real createRedemption rollback when the graph rejects a packed-rate or timeline-boundary insertion is not a distinct test. Standalone graph rejection and real signed-product rejection are tested.

Positive-risk global-cap branch, multiple risk classes, and Gauge-to-real-PermissionedProxy authority composition have no test. All normal execution tests use risk0; individual WAD cap mismatch has a retained candidate.
Multi-voter balance changes are not tested. Single-voter clear/revote/expiry counterexamples are preserved.
Private voter registry uniqueness is not observed; tests check externally visible contribution removal and repeat-clear rejection.
Proxy target callback behavior is not exercised. Operator and selector authority, value/calldata forwarding, and target failure are tested.

Arbitrary corrupted dynamic offsets/length words and complete outer-calldata mutation lack a semantic oracle. Valid format partitions, truncation, invalid words, wrong-token mutation and two-action behavior are tested.
Arbitrary title escaping is not tested. Tests use production constant titles and independently decode serialized ID/SVG content.

domain_limits_separate_from_semantic_gap: Arithmetic symbolic operands and enum branches are bounded exactly as documented. Full-width mulDiv/Q arithmetic use a Forge differential oracle; no full-width formal equivalence is claimed.
Graph symbolic timelines are concrete; independent four-interval fuzz models cover40 blocks. Packed product extrema and all arbitrary histories are not proven.

Transmuter uses actual bytecode with benign exact-transfer ERC20s and a 1:1 mock Alchemist; real Alchemist/VaultV2 refinement belongs to the root suite. External nonidentity share-price rounding is not established here.
Decimals0/6/8/12/18 and overflow78 are explicit. The rest of the uint8 domain is not enumerated.
NFT serializers and ZeroX slicing have large/nested loops. Their FUZZ classifications must not be promoted to universal proofs based on one concrete execution.
ZeroX encoded formats match this source implementation. Conformance to the current external 0x API and the interpretation of bps as slippage remain unverified.
loop_and_vacuity_notes: Use loop budgets that reach all assertions. The full graph tree needs at least34 iterations per Fenwick loop; ZeroX ABI copy loops can require hundreds of iterations. Check Halmos incomplete-path reports.
Metadata tests have serialization and independent decoder loops. Run as concrete/fuzz tests unless a separate tractability strategy is supplied.

No vm.assume appears in these suites; constructive positive domains avoid discarded paths. Intended-success calls are followed by accounting/output assertions; expected rejects assert exact error data or selectors plus relevant unchanged state.

Gauge nonempty allocations require a disclosed seedStrategy harness because the production registerNewStrategy leaves strategyList empty. Do not describe these cases as reachable production allocation proofs.

The original ZX-ACTIONS obligation assumed empty-list rejection; source accepts the empty list and the new characterization test records that mismatch. The source also accepts zero-length slices beyond the end, so blanket out-of-bounds rejection is not established.

restoration.method: Exact source creation and incremental mutation replay from this agent transcript in an isolated temporary directory. No formatted code was used as reconstruction input.

execution_note: No Halmos run. The final one-case Forge fixture check passed 1352 functions and failed 1; candidate tests were excluded. Individual smoke results are not formal proofs.
